code:
x_i + x_j - 2*x_i*x_j

x_i=0, x_j=0:  0+0-0 = 0   (not cut, correct)
x_i=0, x_j=1:  0+1-0 = 1   (cut, correct)
x_i=1, x_j=0:  1+0-0 = 1   (cut, correct)
x_i=1, x_j=1:  1+1-2 = 0   (not cut, correct)
caption: Sum this over every edge, then minimize the negative, to get the full Max-Cut QUBO: f(x) = -sum(x_i + x_j - 2*x_i*x_j).
